faqs.a:
(a)
All licenses issued pursuant to this chapter shall expire on December 31, unless canceled,
               suspended or revoked, and shall be renewed annually upon application for renewal and
               payment of the annual license fee.
(b)
The renewal application shall be reviewed by the city clerk who shall have the power
               to grant or deny such license renewal and to impose reasonable limitations and restrictions
               of any license renewed. The city clerk shall evaluate the application under the criteria
               set forth for original applications.
(Code 1981, § 23-5; Ord. No. 3238, § 1, 12-18-1995)
